title: Pick the sentence that says the same thing
intro: You will see a message a person wanted to say, the keywords they typed, and two sentences, A and B, a writing tool might offer.
First say which sentence matches the original message on one feature (it is named in the question). Then say which sentence you would tap if you had typed those keywords.

help.text: Look only at the one feature named in question 1 (for example 'not', a question or request, or polite wording). both equally if both match it as well as each other; neither if neither does.
Imagine you typed those keywords and meant the original message. A, B, or neither if you would tap neither.

q1_neg.title: Same thing about 'not'?
q1_neg.text: Which sentence says the same thing as the original message about whether it is negated (says something is NOT so)?

q1_act.title: Same thing: question or request?
q1_act.text: Which sentence says the same thing as the original message about whether it is a question or request rather than a plain statement?

q1_pol.title: Same thing about politeness?
q1_pol.text: Which sentence says the same thing as the original message about whether it uses polite wording (please, thank you, could you)?

q2.title: Which would you tap?
q2.text: If you had typed those keywords, which sentence would you tap to say your message?

blocks.label: The original message
blocks.text: I do not like loud music.

blocks.label: Sentence B
blocks.text: I do not like loud music.

practice.fb: Only B keeps the 'not' of the original message, so B says the same thing about negation and is the one to tap.
The original asks someone to do something; B does too, A is a plain statement.
